Due to the weight of this item, it will require assistance with unloading & moving at point of delivery.

The Blyss 10Ltr Dehumidifier is a compact and reliable appliance designed to extract up to 10Ltr of excess moisture per day from domestic spaces. Ideal for trade professionals drying out damp plaster or homeowners managing humidity in bedrooms and living areas, this unit effectively prevents mould growth and damp odours. Featuring a 2-speed setting, a 2Ltr water tank, and a continuous drainage facility, this 280W machine ensures hassle-free operation. The quiet running design and integrated carry handle allow for flexible, non-disruptive placement in rooms up to 60 cubic metres.
b: Mould Prevention Enhances Indoor Air Quality
